integrity: Symbolic rational identities and positivity establish the theorem; 60 finite exact full-matrix tests independently check the formula, but are not an infinite proof. Originality is supported by targeted published-comparison searches, with unindexed-work risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to two equal finite positive gains and the unweighted barbell of two equal cliques of order at least three; no claims for unequal gains, unequal cliques, varying bridge weights, or more than two leaders.
title: Gain-uniform peripheral two-leader optimality on bridge barbells
